title: Document Controller
content_text: Document Controller, Truganina data centre (CPB with UGL and EIC). Managing drawing and document flow, registers, issuing/tracking/archiving, supporting engineers/subcontractors with submissions, review workflows, revisions, reports and records. Likely brings experience in document control, project administration or similar support role; document management systems and Microsoft Office. No agencies.
apply_instructions: Apply on CPB's PageUp careers page (job 1005896). Agency applications not accepted.
